description: Send email from the member's Applystead Mailbox: drafts, replies, held replies, drafted replies, outreach and campaigns, and turn automatic replies on or off. Actions: send_draft, reply, confirm_held_reply, send_ai_reply, full_auto_replies, send_outreach, send_campaign. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.

campaign_id.description: A campaign's id from get_outreach campaigns (campaigns[].id).

key.description: The item's key as the matching list answered it.

mail_message_id.description: A received message's id: its Mailbox id (i-…) or the same id without "i-" (a calendar event's or RSVP draft's mailMessageId); either works.

outreach_id.description: An outreach message or thread id from get_outreach.

params.description: Fields for the action. Call with action "help" to list each action's fields.

name: send_email
title: Send email
